title: Visibility Across Ranks
description: Three different customers each book a shipment. A dispatcher should see the whole fleet at a glance; each customer should only ever see their own crate. Prove the listing endpoint's visibility rule holds consistently across every role at once.
successCondition: As three separate customer accounts, each book exactly one shipment (three total, three distinct customerIds). GET /api/booking as each customer returns a shipments array containing exactly 1 shipment — their own, confirmed by matching customerId. GET /api/booking as a dispatcher account and separately as an admin account each return a shipments array that includes all 3 shipment ids. No customer's list contains either of the other two customers' shipment ids.
hints: Track shipmentId -> customerId as you create the three bookings so the final cross-check is a straightforward set comparison.
The dispatcher/admin lists may contain more than 3 shipments if the environment has pre-existing data — assert by containment of your 3 known ids, not by exact array length.
